atlases.name: cups
atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Production transparent sprite atlas for a cozy cafe game.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 is the approved cafe scene; image 2 approved furniture sprites. Match their softly rounded shapes, rich amber and cream highlights, chestnut-brown outlines, warm autumn palette, hand painted pixel clusters, charming polished pixel-art. The image is an atlas of isolated small food object sprites, NOT a scene. Each sprite uses a consistent elevated three-quarter view with visible top surface and front. Coarse crisp pixel edges, clear readable silhouettes, restrained detail, no smooth vector outlines, no realism. Truly transparent background and transparent gaps; never a checkerboard drawing. All items centered fully inside their cells with at least 18% transparent padding on every side. No ground, no cast ground shadows, no additional props, labels, numbers, gridlines, text, logos, frames or watermarks. Every requested cell is separate, nothing overlaps or touches another cell.
Primary request: redraw four EMPTY modular drink vessels for the game's recipe compositor. This is a CUTOUT SPRITE SHEET. Use a 2 columns by 2 rows square atlas with one small vessel in the CENTER HALF of each cell and huge empty transparent margins.
Row 1 left: an empty round ivory ceramic coffee cup, one large curved handle on its right, no saucer. Its top is a broad elliptical OPEN HOLE with actual fully transparent alpha inside; draw only a cream ceramic rim around the open hole, and opaque cream cup exterior beneath it.
Row 1 right: an empty clear glass tea mug, rounded with one curved handle on its right. The top opening and interior body are fully transparent, with only a warm golden glass rim, thin brown glass outline and a few pale cream reflection stripes on side edges.
Row 2 left: an empty tall clear glass for milk, gently tapered sides, thick rounded glass base, no handle. Top opening and center body fully transparent, pale cream rim and a few thin warm edge highlights.
Row 2 right: an empty slightly wider tall clear glass for fruit juice, gently tapered sides, rounded base, no handle. Top opening and center body fully transparent, pale amber rim and a few thin cream edge highlights.
Critical: these are overlay layers, so inside each cup there must be true alpha transparency. No liquid, no fill, no foam, no toppings, no black or white opaque interiors. Keep fully transparent outside each vessel too. No plates, no shadows. Warm chunky rounded pixel art matching the cafe reference, no white photorealistic glass.
